how-23-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the beach, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-23-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the beach, then tap three things you notice.

how-23-02-compare.page: Put the pad under one tray and the net under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Try the cleanup. Then swap and try again.
how-23-02-compare.say: Put the pad under one tray and the net under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Try the cleanup. Then swap and try again.

how-23-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-23-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-23-02-det.page: Pick 3 cases, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick the cleanup method. Predict whether it worked, and watch the place today appear.
how-23-02-det.say: Pick three cases, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick the cleanup method. Predict whether it worked, and watch the place today appear.

how-23-02-partc.page: Draw a polluted lake before and after a cleanup with your best method. Label the pollution and the tool, and one living thing that is helped.
how-23-02-partc.say: Draw a polluted lake before and after a cleanup with your best method. Label the pollution and the tool, and one living thing that is helped.
